description: Schema 1 of <manifest_dir>/.corridorkey_job.lock (JSON, created O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW). Liveness is the file MTIME (utime every heartbeat_interval_s); 'heartbeat' is only the creation time. Proof of death (same host only): pid absent, OR /proc/<pid>/stat starttime != proc_start_ticks, OR boot_id != current boot_id. A stale mtime alone never proves death. Null fields mean 'unknown': treat as unprovable. 'platform' is sys.platform: on 'linux' proc_start_ticks is /proc/<pid>/stat field 22; on 'win32' it is the process creation FILETIME (100 ns units since 1601) and boot_id is null, so on Windows only 'pid gone' or 'creation time differs' prove death. Same-host proof only; a different host proves nothing.
